traits.habitat_notes: Sphagnum bogs, fens, swamps, peaty gravels, wet sand, lake and stream margins, seeps (FNA); forest understories, wet meadows, high moors (FOC).

taxon.note: Scientific and common names as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form chosen from the plant's habit: a tiny rosette of long-stalked round leaves fringed with red sticky glands, with a slender leafless scape of small white flowers.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

allometry.note: 0.23 m tall at 3 years in the open, inside the floras' range of heights, as grown. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Every look comes from the characters through the library's rules: a tiny rosette of long-stalked round leaves fringed with red sticky glands, with a slender leafless scape of small white flowers.

traits.library_form.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): a small perennial rosette herb: forb.

traits.life_span.note: Flora of China vol. 8 (2001), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): herbs perennial.

traits.woodiness.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Droseraceae family account (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): herbs.

traits.leaf_habit.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): plants form winter hibernaculae (Wikipedia: a bud of tightly curled leaves at ground level); the summer rosette dies back.

traits.rosette.note: Flora of China vol. 8 (2001), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaves basal, dense, long-petiolate.

traits.cauline_leaves.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): scapes 5-35 cm, glabrous (leafless).

traits.height_typical_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): scapes 5-35 cm; Wikipedia: inflorescence 5-25 cm tall; FOC 8.5-30 cm.

traits.height_max_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): scapes to 35 cm.

traits.crown_width_max_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): rosettes (2-)4-10(-15) cm across; Wikipedia: a typical plant 3-5 cm across.

traits.stem_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): stems 1-2 cm; FOC: stem short, to 5 cm when growing up through Sphagnum.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Flora of China vol. 8 (2001), Droseraceae family account (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaves basal and rosulate (spirally set).

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: Flora of China vol. 8 (2001), Droseraceae family account (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): rosulate basal leaves; spiral as in the order's default.

traits.leaf_posture.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaves erect to prostrate.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): blade suborbiculate, broader than long; FOC orbicular, suborbicular or weakly reniform.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): blade 0.4-1 cm long; FOC 3-10 mm, the 3 as low.

traits.leaf_width_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): blade 5-12 mm wide; FOC 0.5-2 cm, the 2 cm as high.

traits.petiole_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): petiole 1.5-5 cm, glandular-pilose; FOC flat, 1-7 cm (taken as low and high); Wikipedia 1.3-5 cm, narrow and hairy.

traits.leaf_margin.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): blades unlobed; margin fringed only by the stalked glands.

traits.stipules.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): stipules adnate to the petiole for their whole length, 4-6 mm, fringed along the distal half; FOC 5-7-fid, 6-8 mm, scarious.

traits.glandular_hairs.note: Flora of China vol. 8 (2001), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaf blades with red, long, capitate, sticky glandular hairs; Wikipedia: the upper surface densely covered.

traits.glandular_hair_length_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: the stalked glands (tentacles) are longest at the blade margin, a few mm, shorter toward the centre; no flora gives a length.

traits.hair_colour.note: Flora of China vol. 8 (2001), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): glandular hairs red; sRGB by eye for the word.

traits.leaf_colour.note: Flora of China vol. 8 (2001), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaf blades yellowish green or green to red (FNA genus: red on both faces in strong sun, greener in shade); sRGB by eye for 'yellowish green'.

traits.vernation.note: Flora of China vol. 8 (2001), Droseraceae family account (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): juvenile leaf blade circinate.

traits.inflorescence.note: Flora of China vol. 8 (2001), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): cincinni 1 or 2, 3-30-flowered (one-sided coiled cymes); Wikipedia: flowers on one side of a single slender stalk.

traits.inflorescence_posture.note: Flora of China vol. 8 (2001), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): inflorescences erect, scapiform, slender.

traits.units_per_inflorescence.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): inflorescences 2-15(-25)-flowered; FOC 3-30.

traits.peduncle_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): scapes 5-35 cm, glabrous (the scape is the bare stalk below the flowers).

traits.inflorescence_length_m.note: A model estimate (confidence low), as no source read gives it: the coiled flowering tip of the scape uncurls to about 2-6 cm with its 2-15 flowers on 1-3 mm pedicels.

traits.pedicel_length_m.note: Flora of China vol. 8 (2001), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): pedicels 1-3 mm.

traits.flower_size_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): flowers 4-7 mm across.

traits.flower_merosity.note: Flora of China vol. 8 (2001), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): sepals 5, petals 5 (Wikipedia five-petalled).

traits.perianth.note: Flora of China vol. 8 (2001), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): sepals 5, petals 5.

traits.sepal_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): sepals joined at the base, oblong, 4-5 x 1.5-2 mm; FOC about 4 mm.

traits.petal_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): petals 5-6 x 3 mm.

traits.petal_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): petals spatulate.

traits.flower_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): petals white or pink (FOC white or tinged pink); sRGB by eye for 'white'.

traits.calyx_colour.note: Flora of China vol. 8 (2001), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): sepals green, glandular; sRGB by eye for the word.

traits.stamens.note: Flora of China vol. 8 (2001), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): stamens 5, 4-5 mm.

traits.stamen_length_m.note: Flora of China vol. 8 (2001), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): stamens 4-5 mm.

traits.carpels.note: Flora of China vol. 8 (2001), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): placentas 3; styles 3 or 4, deeply parted.

traits.fruit_type.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): capsules 5 mm.

traits.fruit_size_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): capsules 5 mm.

traits.capsule_valves.note: Flora of China vol. 8 (2001), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): capsule 3- or 4-valved.

traits.fruit_colour_ripe.note: A model estimate (confidence low), as no source read gives it: a ripe dry capsule pale brown, inside the persistent withered sepals and petals; sRGB by eye.

traits.flowering_months.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): flowering June-September.

traits.fruiting_months.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: capsules ripen some weeks after each flower, July to October, in the North American range.

traits.leaf_out_months.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: rosettes unfold from the hibernaculum in spring after snowmelt, April-May.

traits.leaf_fall_months.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: summer leaves die back as the hibernaculum forms in autumn, September-October.

traits.leaf_colour_autumn.note: A model estimate (confidence low), as no source read gives it: leaves redden in strong light and as they age; dying leaves dull red to brown before the winter bud forms; sRGB by eye.

traits.elevation_min_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): 0-3000 m.

traits.elevation_max_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): 0-3000 m (FOC sea level to 1500 m).

traits.light.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaves red in strong sunlight, greener in shade; FOC forest understories and wet sunny open areas.

traits.moisture.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): Sphagnum bogs, fens, swamps, wet sand, seeps.

traits.soil_texture.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): peaty gravels, sandy soil, wet sand (peat, the commonest substrate, has no state).

traits.habitat_notes.note: Flora of North America vol. 6 (2015), Drosera rotundifolia (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): habitats as listed; circumboreal, much commoner northward.

traits.rosette_leaves.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read counts it: a rosette 2-10 cm across of long-stalked leaves.

traits.flowering_stems.note: Wikipedia, Drosera rotundifolia (read 2026-10-19): a single flowering stalk from the centre of the rosette.
